# One nominal local controller under unknown energy-conserving coherent errors

29 October 2026. An exact, all-orders positive subcase of the fixed-controller
question. **Arbitrary energy-changing coherent perturbations are not solved.**
The general stationary-observable criterion is ordinary/previous machinery;
this file constructs an explicit strictly local fixed-controller admission
and an unknown coherent error class on the supplied recursive family.

## 1. Nominal data and exact local energy resolution

Take the accepted even RX/RZ family H0=sum_j(I-S_j)/2 with n=n_k physical
qubits, one encoded qubit, check weight <=w, qubit incidence <=D, and the
same corrected logical Pauli algebra O_X,O_Y,O_Z. Use the primary-qualified
geometry and beta>beta_c in the unit-defect-energy convention. All constants
below are independent of k. Let rho0=e^(-beta H0)/Z0.

If A is supported on q qubits, let J(A) be the checks touching that support,
m=|J(A)|<=Dq, and U(A) their union with the native support. Then

    |U(A)|<=q(1+Dw),
    e^(itH0) A e^(-itH0)=e^(itH_A) A e^(-itH_A),
    H_A=sum_(j in J(A))(I-S_j)/2.

Its possible energy differences are integers in [-m,m]. For M=2m+1 and
t_r=2pi r/M, the finite Fourier formula

    A_omega=(1/M)sum_(r=0)^(M-1)
              e^(-i omega t_r)e^(it_r H_A)A e^(-it_r H_A)   (1)

is EXACT: [H0,A_omega]=omega A_omega, A=sum_omega A_omega,
and ||A_omega||<=||A||. Every component has the same bounded support U(A).
For m=0 take A_0=A. This is finite nominal energy resolution, not an
infinite-resolution Davies component of the perturbed Hamiltonian.

In particular the zero-frequency map A->A_0 is an average of unitary
conjugations, is Hermiticity preserving, and contracts the operator norm.
If a globally energy-conserving local V=sum_i V_i satisfies [H0,V]=0, then

    V=sum_i (V_i)_0.                                      (2)

Thus global energy conservation does not require an initially termwise
conserving decomposition. Pinching expands each native support only to its
check neighbourhood and does not increase that term's norm. Its incidence
increases by at most the fixed factor (1+Dw). Formula (1) is a mathematical
local qualification/compiler, not a granted physical averaging actuator.

does not assert robustness during noisy preparation or an efficient native
hardware initializer.

Let m be the number of supplied checks and r=n-1 their independent rank.
The admissible syndrome set Sigma is a binary linear space of size 2^r;
all its syndrome spaces have dimension two. Stabilizer linear algebra
constructs its linear membership constraints in polynomial time from the
known nominal check matrix, including any redundant-check relations.

For sigma in Sigma let C_sigma be the SAME source decoder's Pauli correction,
and let E0 be a Clifford ground-code isometry. Put E_sigma=C_sigma† E0. Then

    pi_beta(sigma)=exp(-beta|sigma|)/Z_syn,
    Enc0(omega)=sum_(sigma in Sigma) pi_beta(sigma)
                                  E_sigma omega E_sigma†.       (1)

This is exactly the corrected-logical product encoder omega tensor tau0.
It does not require preparing a coherent many-body Gibbs vector. Its decoder
measures the nominal syndrome, applies C_sigma, and decodes E0. Phase choices
between syndrome sectors have no effect on this mixed encoding, but one
common correction rule is essential.

For a concrete exact finite-bit contract choose beta=ln B with integer B>=2
above the primary counting threshold. All Gibbs weights and nominal thermal
rates are then rational. Such a choice is possible independently of k.
If desired choose B=B0^4: the sufficient primary counting inequality uses
e^(-beta/4)=1/B0 and is an exact rational/integer inequality after raising
to its fixed positive integer power. This avoids an unqualified real-coin
or exact transcendental comparison oracle.

An explicit sampler draws each supplied check bit independently with
probability p=1/(B+1), and rejects unless the vector is in Sigma. On the
accepted space its probability is precisely proportional to B^(-|sigma|).

# What finite dephasing fails to classicalize exactly

29 October 2026. An all-time analytic admission obstruction, not a memory
counterexample for the recursive family and not a finite-order Zeno model.

## 1. Exact local return kernel

For commuting H0 and one charged Hermitian Pauli P, fix a syndrome vector
|sigma,l>. The span of that vector and P|sigma,l> is invariant under H0+eps P
and stabilizer dephasing. Suppose P flips m checks and the two energies differ
by Delta. The block Hamiltonian is, up to a scalar,

    H_block=(Delta/2)Z+eps X.

If each flipped check dephases with Gamma D_S, the off-diagonal decay rate
is gamma=2Gamma m. Starting from one endpoint population, the Bloch equations
are EXACT:

    x'=-gamma x-Delta y,
    y'=Delta x-gamma y-2eps z,
    z'=2eps y,
    (x,y,z)(0)=(0,0,1).

Eliminating x,y gives the full Volterra equation and Laplace transform

    z'(t)=-4eps² integral_0^t e^[-gamma(t-s)]
                             cos[Delta(t-s)] z(s) ds,
    zhat(p)=1/{p+4eps²(p+gamma)/[(p+gamma)²+Delta²]}.        (1)

For Delta!=0 the kernel has negative lobes at every finite gamma. Even at
Delta=0 it has a finite memory width and z'(0)=0. A nonzero constant-rate
classical two-state Markov chain instead has a nonzero initial population
derivative. Thus this population evolution is not exactly the claimed
time-homogeneous Pauli jump semigroup. A low-frequency approximation would
give a z-decay rate 4eps²gamma/(gamma²+Delta²), but (1) retains the entire
frequency dependence and no such approximation is used as a theorem.
Neither negative projected kernels nor this initial derivative exclude all
larger hidden-state classical realizations; that stronger claim is not made.

## 2. CSS sector separation is a different additional condition

For two independent stabilizer flags s_X,s_Z in {+1,-1}, use unit-check
energy H0=(1-S_X)/2+(1-S_Z)/2 and a local Pauli flipping both. Then
Delta=s_X+s_Z, so (1) depends on the other sector even when one sector's
initial syndrome is fixed. In particular, for the flip probability p=(1-z)/2,

The same-sign and opposite-sign flags have different Delta² (4 and 0),
